name: rn
description: Say what you want, roughly: rn hears what you really want one point at a time, has turn make every piece of work and read it in its receiver's place before you see it, calls you only at the goal sign-off, the ux and the architecture sign-off where your work needs such a document, and the deliverable sign-off, and for what is yours to decide, and resumes from git in any conversation.
